question: Does one additional good reduction disprove a geometric mixed direction on the high equal-class control?
selection: First coefficient-eligible prime greater than 17 and at most 31, excluding no eligible prime. Weighted traces not inspected before freezing.
endpoint: An additional rank-18 reduction with NS discriminant squareclass different from -1 forces characteristic-zero Picard rank 17 and geometric mixed rank zero. A match, higher reduction rank, or failed count leaves UNKNOWN; no further prime is added in this experiment.
boundary: This is a retrospective function-field construction, not an upper bound or selector for either production curve.
